Riley (People Ops): Hi team — need to add my father as a dependent under 'adult dependent due to disability' outside open enrollment. He moved in 2026-02-20 and has a chronic condition. Is this a QLE or special enrollment?
Marta (Benefits): This is typically a Qualified Life Event only if he's newly dependent (financially or residing with you) and meets carrier rules. Some carriers allow mid-year addition for adult dependents with documented disability. We'll need medical proof that meets carrier criteria, proof of residency, and a signed affidavit of support.
Diego (Payroll): FYI premiums may change classification (dependent adult rate). If approved, deductions start the effective date you select; retro deductions billed next payroll.
Riley (People Ops): What counts as 'medical proof'? Doctor letter?
Marta (Benefits): A physician's statement on letterhead describing disability and need for support is typical. We also accept SSA disability award letter or long-term care assessments. Redact sensitive elements if you prefer, but carrier needs enough to confirm eligibility.
Olivia (Manager): @Riley do you need time off to handle admin? We can cover meetings.
Riley (People Ops): Might need 1-2 afternoons next week to finish paperwork. Thanks.
Marta (Benefits): Upload docs to the secure portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/qle-upload (internal). Use subject: 'QLE - Add adult dependent - Riley - 2026-02-20'. If you prefer encrypted email: secure-uploads@redwood.com.
HRbot: Ticket created: HR-5577 — 'QLE add adult dependent: Riley' (assigned to Marta).
Diego (Payroll): If SSA docs take time, put SSN as 'TBD' in portal and update later.
Riley (People Ops): Uploaded physician_letter.pdf and proof_of_residence.jpg. Posted 'uploaded' to portal.
Marta (Benefits): Got them, thanks. I'll validate carrier policies and update within 5 business days. If carrier requires additional docs I'll post here.
Riley (People Ops): Appreciate it.
